answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 29858 Country: India Title: As per the Islamic law is it compulsory for the Muslim women to wear bangles, ear rings, nose rings and secondly if her husband dies should she stop wearing the above things ? Question: As per the Islamic law is it compulsory for the Muslim women to wear bangles, ear rings, nose rings and secondly if her husband dies should she stop wearing the above things ? Answer ID: 29858 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 335/335/M=1432) (1) It is allowed for women to wear bangles, earrings, nose rings and other jewelleries. (2) If any woman's husband dies, she should not wear jewellery and makeup, and give up scent, henna and other items of beautification until her iddah is over. إذا كانت معتدة بت أو موت تترك الزينة بحلى أو حرير أو امتشاط الخ . (در مختار) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
